title: When Cow Urine Cures Constipation on YouTube: Limits of LLMs in Detecting Culture-specific Health Misinformation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs' ability to accurately parse culturally specific Indian health misinformation (gomutra/cow urine discourse) by analyzing their extraction of traditional metaphors versus scientific terms and testing their sensitivity to prompt tone and Western-centric framing.

Comparing linguistic markers (such as certainty amplifiers, hyperbolic terms, and inclusive pronouns) between male and female speakers in the dataset to demonstrate how LLMs risk systematically misreading female-coded rhetorical strategies.
